tagline: Board-engine ramp that turns a field of totems into fuel

featuredCards.title: Nature's Call
featuredCards.caption: Plants totems until all four are standing. Everything else in the deck is paid for by the board you just built.

featuredCards.title: Mana Tide Totem
featuredCards.caption: The engine: with a totem in range, dig three deep or tutor the exact card the turn needs.

featuredCards.title: Fire nova totem
featuredCards.caption: Detonates one of your own totems for 4 damage to everything beside it. The field is ammunition.

featuredCards.title: Elemental fury
featuredCards.caption: The cash-out. Raze up to four totems at once and add every one of them to this card's value.
